title: Simulator: Test Infrastructure
description: Comprehensive enhancement of the LICHEN network simulator covering core engine improvements, topology/mobility, scenario scripting, metrics/analysis, visualization, hardware-in-the-loop integration, and a test scenarios library. The simulator already has substantial capabilities including multi-channel radio medium, propagation modeling, topology generators, YAML scenario DSL, chaos engineering, and Renode HIL support. This epic focuses on filling gaps (visualization, batch runs, recording/replay, real hardware HIL) and ensuring existing features are complete and well-tested.
